_comment: REAL captured NHL api-web responses, 2026-10-03 (ops#377). 'response' is club-schedule-season/SJS/20262027 with away games dropped - fetch_schedule.py discards them before reading anything, and every remaining game object is byte-for-byte as served. 'playoffGame' is the first VGK home game with gameType 3 from club-schedule-season/VGK/20252026, untouched: no SJS playoff game has ever been captured (none are scheduled), so the self-test transplants SJS's own homeTeam object onto it at runtime and changes nothing else. 'tiers' is config/tiers.json as of the same capture, frozen so a later reschedule edit to the live table does not break a test about playoffs.

tiers._comment: PUBLIC tier assignments, transcribed from the official Sharks 2026-27 Game Tiers graphic (public marketing material). Dates are LOCAL game dates at SAP Center. Validated against the live NHL schedule by scripts/fetch_schedule.py - if a date or opponent is wrong, the build fails loudly rather than silently mispricing a game.
tiers._privacy: Tier CREDIT AMOUNTS are deliberately not here. They depend on seat location and are therefore personal - they live in the browser profile only.
